days.headline: TiempOmo Run Club
days.alt: TiempOmo run club runners mid-stride at dusk outside Omo Mercado in Upland
days.description: TiempOmo run club meets at Omo Mercado in Upland at 6:30pm, all ages welcome, with pizza by Crispy Piez after. Bar open 5–11.

days.headline: Cinema & Flights
days.sub: Pan's Labyrinth (2006) on the projector at 8
days.alt: Pan's Labyrinth projected on the screen at Omo Mercado in Upland under red paper lanterns, crowd watching
days.description: Free movie night at Omo Mercado in Upland: Pan's Labyrinth (2006) at 8pm with free popcorn and dessert by Keely's Cake Studio. Natural wine flights $20, $15 for Club Omo members.

days.headline: Jazz in the Side Room
days.alt: Red-lit blur of a drummer's sticks over the cymbals during jazz night at Omo Mercado in Upland
days.description: Live jazz by Stolen Moments in the side room at Omo Mercado in Upland from 7pm, with $10 spritz all day and $8 NA spritz.

days.headline: Lucky Nick's Pizza
days.sub: The final pop up · Celebrating their new restaurant
days.alt: Lucky Nick's Pizza pie with crumbled sausage and parmesan in an open pizza box
days.description: The final Lucky Nick's Pizza pop up at Omo Mercado in Upland, celebrating the opening of their new restaurant. Bar open 5–11.

days.headline: Vinyl Set
days.alt: Close-up of a 45 spinning under the needle on a red-lit turntable at Omo Mercado in Upland
days.description: All-vinyl DJ set by My Boogie Valentine at Omo Mercado in Upland from 7pm. Natural wine bar open 5–11.
